product.name: Reverse Engineering & Product Development
product.description: Service to recreate and improve product designs using 3D scanning and modeling for manufacturing.

product.name: Central R&D & Manufacturing Facility
product.description: A dedicated facility for research, development, and production of 3D printed parts and products.

product.name: Digital Inventory
product.description: A system to store digital designs for on-demand manufacturing of parts, reducing physical inventory needs.

product.name: 3D Printing Hubs Network
product.description: A network of 3D printing centers providing manufacturing services, engineering support, and training.

product.name: SLA Technology
product.description: A 3D printing process using laser to cure photopolymer resin layer by layer for precise and detailed parts.

product.name: SLS Technology
product.description: A 3D printing method that fuses powdered materials using a laser to create durable and complex parts.
